$comment: Agent notes for update payloads, service messages and the remaining available types: what a bot receives in Update and Message fields and the objects nested in them. A union note covers its members; each event note lists its siblings in related. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite, Official means the cited core.telegram.org page.

MessageOrigin.purpose: Where a forwarded or externally replied message came from: a known user, a hidden user, a chat or a channel.

pitfalls.text: Branch on type: only user has a User; hidden_user has just a name; chat and channel carry a Chat.
pitfalls.cite: MessageOriginHiddenUser.sender_user_name: Name of the user that sent the message originally

pitfalls.text: Forwards carry Message.forward_origin; the forward_from* fields were replaced by it in 7.0.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog#december-29-2023

pitfalls.text: reply_to_message is only for the same chat and thread; other replies come as external_reply with their own origin.
pitfalls.cite: Message.reply_to_message: For replies in the same chat and message thread, the original message

pitfalls.text: ExternalReplyInfo.chat and message_id exist only when the original chat is a supergroup or a channel.
pitfalls.cite: ExternalReplyInfo.message_id: Available only if the original chat is a supergroup or a channel.

MaybeInaccessibleMessage.purpose: A message the bot may no longer access: a full Message, or an InaccessibleMessage with only chat, message_id and date.

pitfalls.text: Tell them apart by date: InaccessibleMessage.date is always 0.
pitfalls.cite: InaccessibleMessage.date: Always 0. The field can be used to differentiate regular and inaccessible messages.

pitfalls.text: Arrives in CallbackQuery.message, Message.pinned_message and poll option events: check before reading text or reply_markup.
pitfalls.cite: CallbackQuery.message: MaybeInaccessibleMessage; Message.pinned_message: MaybeInaccessibleMessage

pitfalls.text: For an inaccessible callback message, answer the query and send a new message instead of editing.

MessageReactionUpdated.purpose: Update.message_reaction: one user's or anonymous chat's reaction change on a message, as old and new lists.

pitfalls.text: The bot must be an admin and list "message_reaction" in allowed_updates; an empty list leaves it out.
pitfalls.cite: Update.message_reaction: The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify "message_reaction" in the list of allowed_updates

pitfalls.text: Not sent for reactions set by bots.
pitfalls.cite: Update.message_reaction: The update isn't received for reactions set by bots.

pitfalls.text: user is absent for anonymous reactions; actor_chat is set instead.
pitfalls.cite: actor_chat: The chat on behalf of which the reaction was changed, if the user is anonymous

pitfalls.text: Anonymous-reaction messages send message_reaction_count (totals per ReactionCount): also opt-in, grouped, delayed up to a few minutes.
pitfalls.cite: Update.message_reaction_count: must explicitly specify "message_reaction_count" ... The updates are grouped and can be sent with delay up to a few minutes.

MessageGenerationStopped.purpose: Update.stopped_message_generation: the user pressed Stop on a streamed draft; draft_id says which one.

pitfalls.text: Sent only for drafts streamed with can_stop: true.
pitfalls.cite: sendMessageDraft.can_stop: Pass True to show the user a button to stop further drafts. The bot will receive an Update “stopped_message_generation” if the user presses the button.

pitfalls.text: Stop generating for that draft_id; to keep the partial text, send it as a new message.
pitfalls.cite: sendMessageDraft.keep_on_stop: To fully preserve the partial draft, the bot should send it as a new message.

pitfalls.text: With an explicit allowed_updates list, add "stopped_message_generation" or it never arrives.
pitfalls.cite: getUpdates.allowed_updates: specify ["message", "edited_channel_post", "callback_query"] to only receive updates of these types

BotSubscriptionUpdated.purpose: Update.subscription: a user's Stars subscription to the bot was canceled, re-enabled or failed to renew.

pitfalls.text: state is canceled (user canceled), active (re-enabled) or failed (payment failed).
pitfalls.cite: state: Currently, it can be one of “canceled” if the user canceled the subscription, “active” if the user re-enabled a previously canceled subscription, or “failed” if payment for the subscription failed.

pitfalls.text: No charge id, only user and invoice_payload: make the payload identify the subscription.
pitfalls.cite: BotSubscriptionUpdated fields: user, invoice_payload, state

pitfalls.text: With an explicit allowed_updates list, include "subscription".
pitfalls.cite: getUpdates.allowed_updates: specify ["message", "edited_channel_post", "callback_query"] to only receive updates of these types

VideoChatStarted.purpose: Service message Message.video_chat_started: a video chat began; siblings report scheduling, invites and the end.

pitfalls.text: It holds no fields: test the key's presence ({} is falsy in Python).
pitfalls.cite: VideoChatStarted: Currently holds no information.

pitfalls.text: VideoChatScheduled.start_date is when an admin is supposed to start it, not a guarantee.
pitfalls.cite: start_date: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the video chat is supposed to be started by a chat administrator

pitfalls.text: VideoChatEnded.duration is in seconds.
pitfalls.cite: VideoChatEnded.duration: Video chat duration in seconds

ChatOwnerChanged.purpose: Service message Message.chat_owner_changed: the chat has a new owner; chat-level siblings report the owner leaving and timer changes.

pitfalls.text: chat_owner_left (ChatOwnerLeft) is another event: its optional new_owner only takes over if the owner does not return.
pitfalls.cite: ChatOwnerLeft.new_owner: The user who will become the new owner of the chat if the previous owner does not return to the chat

pitfalls.text: MessageAutoDeleteTimerChanged.message_auto_delete_time is in seconds.
pitfalls.cite: message_auto_delete_time: New auto-delete time for messages in the chat; in seconds

pitfalls.text: Re-read the admin list after an ownership event if the bot relies on who the owner is.

BackgroundType.purpose: The kind of chat background in Message.chat_background_set (ChatBackground.type): fill, wallpaper, pattern or chat_theme.

pitfalls.text: fill and pattern carry a BackgroundFill: solid (color), gradient (two colors and an angle) or freeform_gradient (3 or 4 colors); colors are RGB24 integers.
pitfalls.cite: BackgroundFillFreeformGradient.colors: A list of the 3 or 4 base colors that are used to generate the freeform gradient in the RGB24 format

pitfalls.text: chat_theme has only theme_name, usually an emoji: no colors to read.
pitfalls.cite: BackgroundTypeChatTheme.theme_name: Name of the chat theme, which is usually an emoji

pitfalls.text: wallpaper and pattern carry a Document: download it with getFile to show it.
pitfalls.cite: BackgroundTypeWallpaper.document: Document with the wallpaper

Giveaway.purpose: Message.giveaway: a scheduled giveaway post; service messages report its creation and its result.

pitfalls.text: Four fields: giveaway_created, giveaway (the post), giveaway_winners (public winners), giveaway_completed (no public winners).
pitfalls.cite: Message.giveaway_winners: A giveaway with public winners was completed; Message.giveaway_completed: Service message: a giveaway without public winners was completed

pitfalls.text: GiveawayWinners.winners lists up to 100 users: use winner_count for the total.
pitfalls.cite: winners: List of up to 100 winners of the giveaway

pitfalls.text: prize_star_count is only for Star giveaways, premium_subscription_month_count only for Premium ones.
pitfalls.cite: prize_star_count: for Telegram Star giveaways only; premium_subscription_month_count: for Telegram Premium giveaways only

pitfalls.text: Message.boost_added (ChatBoostAdded.boost_count) is a separate service message about a user boosting the chat.
pitfalls.cite: Message.boost_added: Service message: user boosted the chat

ChecklistTasksDone.purpose: Service message Message.checklist_tasks_done: checklist tasks were marked done or not done, by task id.

pitfalls.text: Only task ids: read the tasks from checklist_message, which may be absent.
pitfalls.cite: checklist_message: Message opt | Message containing the checklist whose tasks were marked as done or not done

pitfalls.text: Added tasks come as checklist_tasks_added with full ChecklistTask objects.
pitfalls.cite: ChecklistTasksAdded.tasks: List of tasks added to the checklist

pitfalls.text: ChecklistTask.completion_date is 0 when not completed; completed_by_user or completed_by_chat says who did it.
pitfalls.cite: completion_date: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the task was completed; 0 if the task wasn't completed

PollOptionAdded.purpose: Service message Message.poll_option_added: an option was added to a poll; poll_option_deleted reports removals.

pitfalls.text: Key options by persistent_id, not by index: it survives additions and deletions.
pitfalls.cite: PollOption.persistent_id: Unique identifier of the option, persistent on option addition and deletion

pitfalls.text: poll_message is optional and may be an InaccessibleMessage: check it before reading the poll.
pitfalls.cite: poll_message: MaybeInaccessibleMessage opt | Message containing the poll to which the option was added, if known.

pitfalls.text: PollOption.voter_count may be 0 when unknown.
pitfalls.cite: voter_count: Number of users who voted for this option; may be 0 if unknown

InputPollOptionMedia.purpose: Media for a poll option you send (InputPollOption.media); received options carry PollMedia.

pitfalls.text: No audio or documents: PollMedia says they can't be received in a poll option.
pitfalls.cite: PollMedia.audio: currently, can't be received in a poll option

pitfalls.text: A link is InputMediaLink {type: "link", url}; it comes back as PollMedia.link (Link).
pitfalls.cite: InputMediaLink.type: Type of the media, must be link

pitfalls.text: InputMediaSticker: an HTTP URL works only for .WEBP; upload .TGS or .WEBM with attach://.
pitfalls.cite: media: pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a .WEBP sticker from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new .WEBP, .TGS, or .WEBM sticker

pitfalls.text: PollMedia holds at most one media field.
pitfalls.cite: PollMedia: At most one of the optional fields can be present in any given object.

SuggestedPostPaid.purpose: Service message Message.suggested_post_paid: the channel was paid for a suggested post; siblings cover approval, decline and refund.

pitfalls.text: currency XTR: Stars in star_amount; currency TON: amount in nanograms.
pitfalls.cite: amount: The amount of the currency that was received by the channel in nanograms; for payments in TON grams only

pitfalls.text: SuggestedPostPrice.amount is in Stars (5-100000) or nanograms (10000000-10000000000000).
pitfalls.cite: SuggestedPostPrice.amount: price in Telegram Stars must be between 5 and 100000, and price in nanograms must be between 10000000 and 10000000000000

pitfalls.text: Approval can fail for lack of user funds (suggested_post_approval_failed).
pitfalls.cite: SuggestedPostApprovalFailed: Currently, only caused by insufficient user funds at the time of approval.

pitfalls.text: A refund follows as suggested_post_refunded: reason post_deleted or payment_refunded.
pitfalls.cite: SuggestedPostRefunded.reason: one of “post_deleted” ... or “payment_refunded”

CommunityChatJoined.purpose: Service message Message.community_chat_joined: a user joined the chat from a community (a group of chats).

pitfalls.text: Store Community.id as a 64-bit integer: it can exceed 32 bits.
pitfalls.cite: Community.id: This number may have more than 32 significant bits

pitfalls.text: community_chat_added and community_chat_removed are about the chat or the bot itself; CommunityChatRemoved is empty, so test the key.
pitfalls.cite: CommunityChatRemoved: Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being removed from a community. Currently holds no information.

GiftInfo.purpose: Service message Message.gift: a regular gift was sent or received; Message.gift_upgrade_sent reuses it for a later upgrade.

pitfalls.text: With is_private, sender and text are for the receiver only: never repost them.
pitfalls.cite: is_private: True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver

pitfalls.text: owned_gift_id is present only for gifts received on behalf of business accounts.
pitfalls.cite: owned_gift_id: only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts

pitfalls.text: convert_star_count is omitted when the gift can't be converted to Stars.
pitfalls.cite: convert_star_count: omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible

UniqueGiftInfo.purpose: Service message Message.unique_gift: a unique (collectible) gift was sent, received, upgraded or bought.

pitfalls.text: origin is upgrade, transfer, resale, gifted_upgrade or offer; expect new values.
pitfalls.cite: origin: Currently, either “upgrade” ..., “transfer” ..., “resale” ..., “gifted_upgrade” ..., or “offer”

pitfalls.text: last_resale_amount is Stars or nanograms, by last_resale_currency (XTR or TON).
pitfalls.cite: last_resale_amount: the price paid for the gift in either Telegram Stars or nanograms

pitfalls.text: is_private: sender and text are for the receiver only.
pitfalls.cite: is_private: True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver

pitfalls.text: transfer_star_count is omitted if the bot can't transfer the gift; a past next_transfer_date means it can now.
pitfalls.cite: next_transfer_date: If it is in the past, then the gift can be transferred now.

PaidMessagesWaived.purpose: Service message Message.paid_messages_waived: the sender used a link that lets them message the user without paying Stars.

pitfalls.text: Empty object: test the key's presence ({} is falsy in Python).
pitfalls.cite: PaidMessagesWaived: Currently holds no information.

pitfalls.text: It is not a payment: don't thank the sender or grant paid access.
Price changes come as paid_message_price_changed: Stars per message from non-admin users of the supergroup.
pitfalls.cite: PaidMessagePriceChanged.paid_message_star_count: The new number of Telegram Stars that must be paid by non-administrator users of the supergroup chat for each sent message

DirectMessagesTopic.purpose: Message.direct_messages_topic: which topic of a channel's direct messages chat holds the message, and who created it.

pitfalls.text: Reply with direct_messages_topic_id = topic_id: it is required when sending to a direct messages chat.
pitfalls.cite: sendMessage.direct_messages_topic_id: required if the message is sent to a direct messages chat

pitfalls.text: topic_id can exceed 32 bits: store it as a 64-bit integer.
pitfalls.cite: topic_id: This number may have more than 32 significant bits

pitfalls.text: The channel's price changes arrive as direct_message_price_changed; direct_message_star_count defaults to 0.
pitfalls.cite: DirectMessagePriceChanged.direct_message_star_count: Defaults to 0.

TonWalletCard.purpose: ChatFullInfo.ton_wallet_card: the TON wallet card shown to everyone on a user's profile.

pitfalls.text: amount is a decimal string in the smallest units: parse it as a big integer.
pitfalls.cite: amount: String | Balance of the wallet, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number

pitfalls.text: Stickers are NFTs placed by AreaPosition percentages; background_nft_address picks one sticker's colors, omitted means default.
pitfalls.cite: background_nft_address: Address of the NFT of one of the stickers, whose colors must be used for the card background; omitted if the default background must be used

pitfalls.text: Message.ton_wallet_transfer (TonWalletTransfer): amount negative for outgoing, transaction_id may be empty, comment omitted if encrypted.
pitfalls.cite: TonWalletTransfer.amount: negative for outgoing transfers

pitfalls.text: WidgetQueryWallet has public_key and state_init both or neither.
pitfalls.cite: state_init: omitted if and only if public_key is omitted

StoryAreaType.purpose: What a clickable area on a story does: location, suggested reaction, link, weather or unique gift.

pitfalls.text: Per story: up to 10 location, 5 suggested reaction, 3 link, 3 weather and 1 unique gift area.
pitfalls.cite: StoryAreaTypeLocation: Currently, a story can have up to 10 location areas. (5, 3, 3 and at most 1 in the other types)

pitfalls.text: StoryAreaTypeWeather.background_color is ARGB, not RGB.
pitfalls.cite: background_color: A color of the area background in the ARGB format

pitfalls.text: Each StoryArea pairs a type with an AreaPosition in percentages of the media.
pitfalls.cite: AreaPosition.x_percentage: The abscissa of the area's center, as a percentage of the media or the card width

UsersShared.purpose: Service message Message.users_shared: users picked with a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button; chat_shared is the chat version.

pitfalls.text: Match request_id to the button: it is your signed 32-bit id, unique within the message.
pitfalls.cite: KeyboardButtonRequestUsers.request_id: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request that will be received back in the UsersShared object. Must be unique within the message.

pitfalls.text: A shared user_id or chat_id may be unusable unless the bot already knows that user or chat.
pitfalls.cite: SharedUser.user_id: The bot may not have access to the user and could be unable to use this identifier

pitfalls.text: Names, username and photo come only if the button requested them.
pitfalls.cite: first_name: First name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot

pitfalls.text: request_users, request_chat and request_poll (KeyboardButtonPollType: quiz, regular or any) work in private chats only.
pitfalls.cite: KeyboardButton.request_users: Available in private chats only.

WriteAccessAllowed.purpose: Service message Message.write_access_allowed: the user allowed the bot to write to them, and through which path.

pitfalls.text: Four origins: from_request (requestWriteAccess), web_app_name (Mini App opened from a link), from_attachment_menu, inviter (owner invite).
pitfalls.cite: WriteAccessAllowed: after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess, or about a user being invited to the private chat with the bot by the owner of the bot

pitfalls.text: inviter is the bot owner, who invites up to 10 users at once via https://t.me/botinvite/<bot_username>.
pitfalls.cite: inviter: Bot owners can invite up to 10 users at once by pressing the link https://t.me/botinvite/<bot_username>.

WebAppData.purpose: Service message Message.web_app_data: what a Mini App opened from a reply-keyboard web_app button sent to the bot.

pitfalls.text: data and button_text can be forged by a bad client: validate them, never authorize on them.
pitfalls.cite: data: Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

pitfalls.text: Only Mini Apps launched from a KeyboardButton can send it (up to 4096 bytes, then the app closes); inline-button Mini Apps use answerWebAppQuery.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps

InlineKeyboardButton.purpose: One inline keyboard button: a label plus exactly one action field.

pitfalls.text: Exactly one field besides text, icon_custom_emoji_id and style.
pitfalls.cite: InlineKeyboardButton: Exactly one of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style must be used to specify the type of the button.

pitfalls.text: callback_data is 1-64 bytes; copy_text (CopyTextButton.text) 1-256 characters.
pitfalls.cite: callback_data: 1-64 bytes; CopyTextButton.text: 1-256 characters

pitfalls.text: web_app: private chats with the bot only, not business or ephemeral messages; login_url: not in ephemeral messages.
pitfalls.cite: web_app: Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account and ephemeral messages.

pitfalls.text: switch_inline_query* buttons fail in channel direct messages and business-account messages.
pitfalls.cite: switch_inline_query: Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

pitfalls.text: callback_game and pay must be the first button in the first row.
pitfalls.cite: pay: This type of button must always be the first button in the first row

BusinessOpeningHours.purpose: ChatFullInfo.business_opening_hours: a business account's weekly opening hours in its own time zone.

pitfalls.text: Intervals are minutes from Monday 00:00: opening_minute 0-7*24*60, closing_minute up to 8*24*60.
pitfalls.cite: opening_minute: The minute's sequence number in a week, starting on Monday ... 0 - 7 * 24 * 60; closing_minute: 0 - 8 * 24 * 60

pitfalls.text: Minutes are in time_zone_name, not UTC.
pitfalls.cite: time_zone_name: Unique name of the time zone for which the opening hours are defined

pitfalls.text: business_intro, business_location and business_opening_hours exist only in private chats with business accounts (getChat).
pitfalls.cite: ChatFullInfo.business_opening_hours: For private chats with business accounts, the opening hours of the business

Birthdate.purpose: ChatFullInfo.birthdate: a user's day and month of birth, year optional, read with getChat on a private chat.

pitfalls.text: year is optional: don't compute an age without it.
pitfalls.cite: Birthdate.year: Integer opt | Year of the user's birth

pitfalls.text: A missing birthdate means hidden or not set: don't retry.
getChat profile siblings: rating (UserRating; a negative level is likely reason for concern), location (ChatLocation, supergroups only), unique_gift_colors.
pitfalls.cite: UserRating.level: a negative level is likely reason for concern; ChatFullInfo.location: For supergroups, the location to which the supergroup is connected

ResponseParameters.purpose: The parameters of a failed response: retry_after for flood control, migrate_to_chat_id when a group became a supergroup.

pitfalls.text: retry_after: wait that many seconds before repeating the request.
pitfalls.cite: retry_after: In case of exceeding flood control, the number of seconds left to wait before the request can be repeated

pitfalls.text: migrate_to_chat_id: store the new supergroup id (64-bit) and retry with it.
pitfalls.cite: migrate_to_chat_id: The group has been migrated to a supergroup with the specified identifier.

VideoQuality.purpose: Another available encoding of a received video (Video.qualities), with its own file_id, size and codec.

pitfalls.text: Each quality has its own file_id: pick by width, height and codec (h264, h265, av01) before getFile.
pitfalls.cite: codec: Codec that was used to encode the video, for example, “h264”, “h265”, or “av01”

pitfalls.text: file_size can exceed 2^31: use a 64-bit integer.
pitfalls.cite: file_size: It can be bigger than 2^31

InputMediaVoiceNote.purpose: A voice message to send inside a Rich message: in InputRichBlockVoiceNote or as InputRichMessageMedia.media.

pitfalls.text: type must be voice_note.
pitfalls.cite: type: Type of the media, must be voice_note

pitfalls.text: In InputRichBlockVoiceNote its caption is ignored: caption the block instead.
pitfalls.cite: InputRichBlockVoiceNote.voice_note: The voice note. Caption is ignored.

PassportFile.purpose: A file of a Telegram Passport element (scans, selfie, translations): download it with getFile, then decrypt it.

pitfalls.text: Files are encrypted: decrypt with the credentials from EncryptedCredentials; decrypted they are JPEG up to 10 MB.
pitfalls.cite: EncryptedPassportElement.files: Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials. PassportFile: all Telegram Passport files are in JPEG format when decrypted and don't exceed 10MB.

pitfalls.text: files exists only for utility_bill, bank_statement, rental_agreement, passport_registration and temporary_registration.
pitfalls.cite: EncryptedPassportElement.files: available only for “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types

EmojiType.purpose: One emoji of a chat share theme (ChatShareThemeEmoji.emojis): a regular emoji or a custom emoji id.

pitfalls.text: Branch on type: emoji carries the character, custom_emoji the custom_emoji_id; resolve it with getCustomEmojiStickers.
pitfalls.cite: EmojiTypeCustomEmoji.custom_emoji_id: Use getCustomEmojiStickers to get full information about the sticker.

pitfalls.text: A theme has 0-6 of them.
pitfalls.cite: ChatShareThemeEmoji.emojis: The emoji; 0-6 regular or custom emoji

PaidMedia.purpose: One item of paid media in PaidMediaInfo: a preview before purchase, else the photo, video or live photo.

pitfalls.text: Branch on type: preview, photo, video, live_photo.
pitfalls.cite: PaidMediaPreview.type: always “preview”; PaidMediaLivePhoto.type: always “live_photo”

pitfalls.text: A preview has no media, only optional width, height and duration as the sender defined them.
pitfalls.cite: PaidMediaPreview: The paid media isn't available before the payment.

ProximityAlertTriggered.purpose: Service message Message.proximity_alert_triggered: a user sharing a live location came within another user's alert distance.

pitfalls.text: The alert comes from proximity_alert_radius (1-100000 m) on a live location in sendLocation or editMessageLiveLocation.
pitfalls.cite: sendLocation.proximity_alert_radius: For live locations, a maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.

pitfalls.text: traveler triggered it, watcher set it.
pitfalls.cite: traveler: User that triggered the alert; watcher: User that set the alert
